sentences: (Photo by Alexander Hassenstein/Getty Images for IAAF) Beijing Secures Hosting Rights for 2027 World Athletics Championships March 1, 2024 Facebook Twitter Pinterest In a historic decision, Beijing, China, has been officially selected as the host city for the prestigious 2027 World Athletics Championships by the World Athletics Council.

Seb Coe: Photo by Philippe Fitte for IAAF “With the announcement of China as our next host, our last four World Athletics Championships have now been awarded to the world’s four largest economies: the USA (Oregon), the EU (Budapest), Japan (Tokyo), and China (Beijing),” added Coe.

The forthcoming 2027 World Athletics Championships, slated to take place 12 years after Beijing’s successful organization of athletics’ premier event and almost two decades following the Beijing Olympic Games, promises to bring together the world’s top athletic talents.
Wang Nan, World Athletics Council Member and Vice President of the Chinese Athletics Association (CAA), expressed gratitude for the acknowledgment and trust bestowed upon China and Beijing.

Zhao Wen, Director of the Beijing Sports Bureau, acknowledged World Athletics’ trust and support for Beijing, highlighting the city’s distinction of hosting both the 15th World Athletics Championships in 2015 and now the 21st edition in 2027.
This significant announcement was made during the 234th World Athletics Council Meeting in Glasgow, conducted ahead of the World Athletics Indoor Championships scheduled from March 1 to 3.

China’s continued prominence in global athletics is underscored by the privilege of hosting next year’s World Athletics Indoor Championships in Nanjing, further solidifying its status on the international stage.
Sebastian Coe, President of World Athletics, extended congratulations to Beijing, emphasizing the vast sports market in China.
Uganda’s Joshua Cheptegei (right) in action during the Men’s 10,000 Metres Final on day three of the World Athletics Championships at Hayward Field, University of Oregon in the United States.

Wang Nan pledged collaborative efforts with the Beijing organizing committee to ensure the championships meet the highest quality standards, contributing significantly to the global development of athletics.

With the recent success of the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympic Games, Zhao Wen eagerly anticipates the return of the World Athletics Family to experience the rich blend of ancient and modern charm in the capital.

Coe pointed out China’s remarkable achievement as the leading performer for Wanda Diamond League broadcast consumption in 2023, presenting an unparalleled opportunity to grow the sport and its fan base in one of the world’s largest commercial markets.
